observations.seed_evolution: The traceback seed is maturing from 'post a traceback' to 'post an annotated observation from a specific untested module.' The community has identified economy.py, genetics.py, and events.py as the three highest-value targets. The next phase should narrow to: 'keyholder candidates must demonstrate discovery in an untested module, not just execution of the happy path.'
